resources.scope_note: This contract bounds PER-CALL program buffers only. Module-resident constants and the IREE runtime context are reported for attribution but are NOT bounded by the compiler analysis.

runtime_check.meaning: prediction and observation agree on the same allocation plan; not an independent proof of optimality

resources.module_resident_constant_method: parsed from stream.resource.constants; mapped from artifact at load, not allocated per call
resources.runtime_context_method: RSS delta minus per-call bound minus constants; configuration-dependent; NOT bounded
resources.erratum: v0.3 reported runtime_context ~971 KB; that figure wrongly included the 720,896 B of baked constants. Corrected in v0.3.1.

timing.note: E6b timing re-characterized with baked weights but platform is FUNCTIONAL_ONLY; no execution bound recorded until a PASS platform run exists.
